title: xi dats copy action
description: A file put into the target as it is: a UI sheet redrawn with `xi ui tex`, a replaced music track. The build writes resources.file at target.path in the install (keeping the file it replaces as <file>.base) or the pivot folder; nothing is registered, so target.path must be a file the client already reads.

path.description: Where the file goes, inside the game folder: ROM/119/51.DAT, sound9/win/music/data/music067.bgw. Forward slashes; no drive, no leading slash, no '..'.

file.description: The file to copy: relative to the project file (what `dats prepare --type copy` writes), projects/resources, or the working folder; or absolute.

result.description: Recorded by dats build: the path the file went to and the targets it went into — what undo takes back out.

examples.description: The title screen, redrawn with xi ui tex import
